summary: Advertising manager of the Sunday Independent (1893–1953), husband of Claire P. Lydon; John's 2nd-great-grand-uncle.
bio: George Paul Heffernan was born on 20 May 1893 and became advertising manager of the Sunday Independent. On 18 April 1927, in Luzerne Co., Pa., he married Claire P. Lydon, and in 1930 they were living in Kingston, Pa. They had two sons, George Paul (1928–2015) and Andrew Humphrey (1929–1998). He died on 17 December 1953 and was buried in St. Mary's Cemetery, Hanover Twp, Pa. He is John's 2nd-great-grand-uncle.
